shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'for f in package.json next.config.ts tsconfig.json app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx app/RevenueChart.tsx app/LatestInvoices.tsx app/CardStats.tsx; do echo "### $f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- package.json && git show HEAD:package.json && rg -n \"cacheComponents|use cache|Uncached data was accessed outside\" node_modules/next/dist -g '*.js' -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,200p'"

/bin/bash -lc "find .next/server/app -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p\\n' | sort | sed -n '1,160p' && rg -n \"Dashboard|Loading dashboard|Revenue\" .next/server/app -g '*.html' -g '*.rsc' | sed -n '1,80p'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit'
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && git diff --stat && git status --short && sed -n '1,180p' app/page.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx'
